Stemwise design

16 · Track chain

P-018. The chain of a track or a group is a list of blocks in any order, like the master’s rack (screen 15), shown in the inspector: Trim first, Fader and Pan last, everything in between free. A new track starts with the five blocks of always; thirteen more can be added, each at most twice, twelve in all. Returns get a short chain of their own after the reverb or the delay. The marks of P-013 follow the list. Replaces the row of chain buttons at the top of the inspector (3a); the rest of the inspector stands.

16a

The chain in the inspector, De-esser open

One row per block, top to bottom, with its label, its value, the reduction it applies and its switch. A block the assistant added is marked New until the proposal is applied; a block that only plays in some sections says where. The selected block opens below the list; Sends stay at the foot (A-065). The header of Lead Vox shows the same labels, in the same order.

Dynamics
GT
GateSilences what sits between the hits
DS
De-esserTwo already
DEQ
Dynamic EQA band that moves only when needed
TR
TransientMore or less attack, no threshold
CMP
CompressorTwo already: remove one first
CLP
ClipperShaves the tallest peaks
MB
MultibandA compressor per range
Tone
HP
High-passRemoves the lows below a frequency
LP
Low-passRemoves the highs above a frequency
EQ
EQFour bands on the spectrum
SAT
SaturationWarmth and grit, four characters
EXC
ExciterAdds sparkle to the top
BAS
Bass enhancerBass you hear on small speakers
Space & movement
WID
WidthNarrower or wider stereo
MOD
ModulationChorus, flanger, phaser
TRM
TremoloLevel or pan that moves in time
Pitch
HRM
HarmonizerVoices at a fixed interval
DBL
DoublerA second performance, inside the track
